description: How the empty-state suggestion chips of TmAiConversation sit in the panel. Wrap (the default) keeps today's wrapping, centred row. ScrollRow is a nowrap horizontal scroller that reveals a partially visible focused chip without moving the transcript. Auto is ScrollRow under 640 px via a CSS container query; desktop Auto stays Wrap.

members.name: Wrap
members.description: The chips wrap and stay centred (the default). The empty-state DOM is unchanged.

members.name: ScrollRow
members.description: A single nowrap row that scrolls horizontally. A partially visible focused chip is revealed inside the row (never by scrolling the transcript or the page).

members.name: Auto
members.description: ScrollRow when the conversation is narrower than 640 px, Wrap otherwise. The switch is a CSS container query.
